notes: ADTRAN 1148V/1148VX datasheet: 4x 1/2.5/10GE SFP interfaces (or GPON/10G PON on the VX-DMT variant); all four uplinks are SFP+/SFP cages, none copper. TA1148V Intl datasheet lists the same 4x1/2,5/10GE SFP interfaces.

Calix GE-2p/FE-4p datasheet: the two GE interfaces are reached through SFP optical transceivers in the card faceplate; only fe1-fe4 are copper (10/100BaseT via adaptor onto the rear RJ-21), so they stay as-is.

cardModelled: E3-48C sealed ESAN uplink complex - 2x 10GE/1GE SFP+ MSA sockets + 3x 1GE/2.5GE SFP MSA sockets
notes: All five uplinks are SFP sockets: xge1/xge2 = 1GE/10GE SFP+ , ge1-ge3 = 1GE/2.5GE SFP (2.5G not represented in speedCaps per issue convention). Copper-uplink r2 build variant exists (Calix EOL notice CAB-21-042) but is not the modelled unit.

cardModelled: H83BCVLE 32-port VDSL2+POTS combo board in a service slot, uplinks from the UP2A/UP2C GE upstream daughter board on the control board (CCUB/CCUC/CCUE)
notes: Huawei MA5616: upstream daughter board UP2A/UP2C exposes port 0 and port 1, both SFP cages (GE1A variant likewise gives GE0/GE1 as SFP); the GP1A variant makes them 2x GPON. No copper GE uplink on this chassis, only the separate ETH craft/management port.

ECNT-C front panel = 4 GE links: 3 GE optical (SFP-1..3) + 1 GE optical/electrical selectable (SFP-4/RJ45). ge1-ge3 are fibre only; ge4 is a genuine combo, so it is left as copper - mark it sfp only if you want the SFP half modelled.

cardModelled: NT controller board - either NANT-D (3x GE SFP 1/2.5G + 1x 10GE SFP+) or the ECNT-C used in the 7330 FTTN XD sealed variant (3x GE optical SFP + 1x combo)
notes: ge1-ge3 are SFP cages under both candidate NT cards, so they are safe. ge4 is ambiguous and deliberately left alone: under NANT-D it is a 10GE SFP+ (would also need speed 10G), under ECNT-C it is a GE SFP/RJ45 combo.
